battlefield_camp.idea: A ruined war camp: a broken palisade ring round a great collapsed tent. Enemies hold the inside, and the tent splits any fight in there in two.

battlefield_graves.idea: A long narrow stretch of old field, rows of graves running up it in staggered blocks, with banners among them. Easy to walk a lane, slow to change lanes, and the dead can be waiting in any of them.

battlefield_heaps.idea: A long narrow stretch of old field, big heaps of war wreckage staggered up its length. A running fight from heap to heap, each one hiding the next stretch.

battlefield_lines.idea: Two old battle lines across a wide field, rows of spears and shields left standing, their gaps not lined up. An advance has to zigzag from one breach to the next while ranged shoot along the lines.

battlefield_mound.idea: A small field with a raised mound in the middle, two stepped ways up its south side, a banner at its foot. Nowhere is far from the top, so the fight is over who stands on it.

battlefield_palisade.idea: Two old palisade lines across a wide field, their gaps not lined up, with banners, wreckage and a collapsed tent between and behind them. An advance has to zigzag from one breach to the next while ranged shoot along the lines.

cider_orchards_clearing.idea: A clearing ringed by apple trees, closed north and south with gaps east and west. Open ground in the middle, with trees to fall back to.

cider_orchards_lane.idea: A lane through the orchard, fenced both sides, with a gate each way halfway up. Keep to the lane, or slip through a gate and come at them through the trees.

cider_orchards_rows.idea: Rows of apple trees run north and south, with one open row across the middle. Long lanes to shoot down, and only one place to change lanes easily.

cider_orchards_terrace.idea: A raised terrace in the orchard, two stepped ways up its south side, apple trees all round. Whoever's on top looks down over the trees' feet.

dark_wood_bend.idea: A cliff fills the map's north-west, leaving an L-shaped run with a web-choked hollow at the corner. Neither side can see round the bend until it's too late: an ambush map.

dark_wood_furrow.idea: A straight furrow worn by something dragged, strewn with bones, runs the length of the map past a web-choked hollow. Bramble masses press in on its west side twice, and the spiders wait by the hollow.

dark_wood_maze.idea: Two bramble walls with gaps at opposite ends: a winding walk for melee, while ranged may shoot straight across if brambles don't stop sight.

dark_wood_surround.idea: The party starts in the middle of a broken ring, a giant and spiders on every side. Four gaps to hold and no back line.

dark_wood_thorns.idea: Bramble masses and dead trees scattered wide, joined into broken walls. A winding walk for melee; ranged may shoot across if brambles don't stop sight.

dark_wood_webs.idea: A band of webbed trees to the north and brambles to the south, each with a clean gap. The webs are a short cut if webs get a rule, and scenery if not.

deep_forest_choke.idea: A wall of rock across the board with one gap. Melee has to come through one cell at a time.

deep_forest_clearing.idea: A big open middle ringed by trees and rock, with nothing to hide behind out there. The edge is the safe place, and room for a giant.

deep_forest_gorge.idea: A long gorge under a cliff, closed twice by fallen trunks that each leave a one-cell gap. A running fight from gap to gap.

deep_forest_groves.idea: Wide ground with groves dotted over it, a big boulder and a rise of raised rock in the west with one way up. No front line: lanes run between the groves and anyone can be flanked.

deep_forest_lanes.idea: Three long lanes, each wall with one gap to cross by. Good for straight-line attacks; flanking means finding the gap.

deep_forest_pocket.idea: A tight pocket ringed by pines, a trunk and a stump in the middle. Everyone is in reach almost at once; only the obstacles buy a turn.

deep_forest_stone_path.idea: An old stone path in a long soft curve through pines, with mossy marker stones beside it. The path is the only long clear run; the pines break up everything to either side.

fey_wood_crescent.idea: A narrow crescent round a stand of trees, on a small hex. Enemies at one tip, party at the other, and the way across is hidden until you round it.

fey_wood_glades.idea: Two glades split by a big grove, with a neck two cells wide below it. Whoever holds the neck holds the fight; giant mushrooms crowd each glade.

fey_wood_hourglass.idea: Two glades joined by a waist three cells wide, with trees either side of it. The straight way is open and the way round goes through the trees.

fey_wood_lights.idea: A line of glowing caps weaves across the map through the trees, with giant mushrooms at its far end. Both sides come at each other along the lights or cut the corners between them.

fey_wood_ring.idea: The fairy ring in the middle of a clearing is the place to fight over, with cover pockets to each side. What the ring does is a rule still to make.

fey_wood_scatter.idea: Single stones scattered evenly, so there are no long straight lines and always something to step round. A skirmish, not a front.

fey_wood_stones.idea: A ring of standing stones round a fairy ring. Each stone is one cell to step behind; what the ring itself does is a rule still to make.

fortified_town_breach.idea: A stretch of town wall and its towers runs across the map on the slant, with two gaps. Everyone has to come through a gap, or wait for the other side to.

fortified_town_corner.idea: The corner of the town wall, a tower at its point. Enemies have their backs to the stone: push them into it, or be pinned against the house.

fortified_town_street.idea: A cobbled street up the map between stone houses and a smithy, a supply wagon stuck in the middle of it. The wagon splits the street in two.

fortified_town_yard.idea: A supply yard round a smithy, with wagons, stores and spear racks scattered about. Lots of small corners and no clear line.

haunted_homesteads_crops.idea: Big blocks of withered crop with a scarecrow standing in each. The crop can be walked through, and the scarecrows break it up into short runs.

haunted_homesteads_house.idea: A tight yard round one boarded-up farmhouse. The house hides half the map, so you're never sure which way round they're coming.

haunted_homesteads_track.idea: A wide farm track across the map between two broken fences, each with gaps. The track is the quick way along, and it's open to both sides.

haunted_homesteads_yards.idea: A long walk through old farmyards, broken fences across it with gaps on alternate sides, houses and dead trees between. A winding advance from yard to yard.

heartwood_great_tree.idea: A huge tree fills the middle, so nobody can come straight at you; the fight goes round it both ways, over its roots and between lesser trees. A rise of raised rock with a stepped way up stands by the party.

heartwood_hollow.idea: A hex pinched in the middle by a cliff from the west and trees from the east, with arching roots as low walls. The cliff's shelter is the prize: back to it, only two sides to watch.

heartwood_island.idea: A great rock mass fills the middle, so the two sides can't reach each other straight on. The fight goes round it, both ways.

heartwood_pillars.idea: Clusters of three stones spaced like pillars, with cells in the open between them. Easy to break line, step out, and step back.

heartwood_prayer_path.idea: A prayer path up the map, under two wooden gates, forking round a small grove and joining again, with big roots walling its top end. Take either arm of the fork, and whoever holds the join reaches both.

heartwood_ridge.idea: A diagonal ridge with two gaps far apart. Holding both means splitting the party, and each side can pick which one to force.

heartwood_shelf.idea: A ridge of raised rock crosses the map's middle, cut by two gaps, with stepped ways up from both sides. Hold the gaps, or take the top: each side picks what to force.

highlands_knoll.idea: A small round knoll inside a ring of cairns, its top held from the start. Short walk, two long flights, and nowhere far from the top.

highlands_moor.idea: An open moor of heather round one big bare mountain, with a clan's banners and cairns on the way. The fight goes round it either side, through heather for cover.

highlands_scarp.idea: A cliff fills the north-west corner, and a raised shelf of grass and bare rock runs down under it on the slant. Two long flights, and a low ridge to get behind on the way.

hills_crags.idea: Up a long slope between two ridges set on the slant, an S to walk, to a raised brow across the top with two flights up.

hills_saddle.idea: Two grassy knolls with a saddle between them. The straight way runs up the saddle under both; each knoll has its own long flight from the south and a shot down the middle.

hills_shoulder.idea: A long grassy shoulder of raised ground along the north, two long flights up its south side. A ridge and a mountain break up the slope below, so climbing means picking a side first.

market_town_aisles.idea: Two long rows of stalls across the map, with crates and carts closing the gaps, one row open at its east end and one at its west. Long runs along them, and a way across only at the end of each row.

market_town_row.idea: Townhouses pressing in on a tight little market. Two pinch points and little room to stand off.

market_town_square.idea: A paved square, stalls and a well in the middle of it, townhouses at its corners. Stalls stop movement but leave lanes all round them.

market_town_street.idea: A wide market street across the map, stalls along both sides of it. Fight in the open street, or slip behind the stalls.

meadows_camp.idea: A nomad camp: eight felt tents in a ring round the fire, with gaps between them. Fight through the ring, or hold a gap and let them come out one at a time.

meadows_herds.idea: Wide open grass with nothing to hide behind but herds, lone trees and drifts of tall flowers. Ranged shine here; the herds are the only walls.

meadows_rise.idea: A grassy rise in the middle of the meadow, a way up on its north and south. Whoever holds the top looks down on everything; everyone else fights for the steps or goes round.

meadows_tents.idea: A long walk up a strip of meadow past outlying tents and rug racks, with a herd at one side. Short walls and no real line: every tent is a corner to step round.

monastery_heights_climb.idea: A stone path zigzags up the map between low walls, climbs a long flight onto a raised terrace and goes on across it. The path is the quick way; a second flight to the east comes up behind the top.

monastery_heights_gardens.idea: A raised terrace at the north, herb gardens in staggered rows below it, and two low walls closing in toward the middle. The gardens block: walk the rows or go through the gap.

monastery_heights_ridge.idea: A big mountain with a raised terrace on its shoulder, three long flights up it. Prayer flags and gardens mark the south; the way round the mountain's west is long.

monastery_heights_walled.idea: A small walled garden with a shaped pine at its heart, gaps north, south, east and west. The walls are low but they stop you: every way in is a door.

raided_farms_barns.idea: A burnt farm spread wide: charred barns, one left standing, small fires and a block of trampled crop in the middle. Big obstacles far apart, with long open runs between.

raided_farms_crossroads.idea: A farm track up the map crossing another in the middle, barricades, fires and spilled crates along it. The crossing is the one wide place, and everyone has to pass it.

raided_farms_fires.idea: A small burnt plot with sheds and fires scattered close together. Nothing big to hide behind, and lots of small things in the way.

raided_farms_stand.idea: The party starts inside a ring of farmers' barricades with four gaps, raiders coming from north and south. A map for holding gaps.

scholars_town_cloister.idea: Two cloister runs on the slant, towers at their heads, make three narrow paved walks, all opening onto a small paved court round a fountain at the south end.

scholars_town_court.idea: A paved quad round a fountain, halls and towers to the north, a cloister and hedges round the rest, gaps on three sides. Hold the fountain, or come at it through any gap.

scholars_town_lawns.idea: A great three-sided quad: a library and cloisters along the north, a gate at the north-east corner to a back walk behind them, where foes hold the gate and come through it, halls and towers at the corners, open to the south. Lawn panels and paved walks cross at a fountain, statues along them. Few corners inside, long runs: ranged shine, and every statue matters.

scholars_town_walk.idea: A broad paved walk up the map, lined with hedges and cloisters, halls and towers beyond them, with a small court off it to the east and a cross walk at the south. Hedges hold you to the walk for much of its length.

slums_fences.idea: Two long patched fences cross the map from opposite sides, leaving one gap each. The way through winds from side to side.

slums_plots.idea: Vegetable plots and scraggly trees behind the shacks. Nothing to hide behind but junk and trees, so everyone is in reach fast.

slums_shacks.idea: Shacks packed close, with crooked alleys between them. Short sight lines and many ways round, with only a small vegetable plot in the open.

slums_street.idea: A muddy street across the map, with junk and trees along it and shacks at both ends, their washing beside them. As wide as any town's, so the party fits, and open to both sides.

snowy_peaks_lake.idea: A frozen lake in a hollow, ringed with snowy pines and ice rocks. The ice is wide open: quickest across, nothing to stand behind.

snowy_peaks_pass.idea: Ice cliffs close in from both sides to a pass one cell wide at the middle, with a frozen pond beyond it. One gap: whoever holds it holds the map.

snowy_peaks_shelf.idea: A raised snow shelf across the whole map, a mountain behind it. Three long flights: two from the south, one from the north, so the shelf can be held or crossed.

stormy_plains_outcrop.idea: A big rock outcrop fills the middle of the map and blocks everything behind it. The fight circles it, with split trees and boulders closing the ring in places.

stormy_plains_scarp.idea: A cliff at the north with a broad terrace of raised ground under it, stepped down to the burnt field. Enemies hold the terrace; there are two stepped ways up, a long way apart.

stormy_plains_spire.idea: The great rock spire fills the middle of the map and blocks everything behind it. The fight circles it, with split trees and boulders closing the ring in places.

stormy_plains_trunks.idea: Lightning has dropped trunks all over a round field, and split trees stand in clumps. Short broken lines everywhere: lots of corners, no long sight lines.

tourney_fields_camp.idea: The knights' camp, spread wide: a grand pavilion with big ones either side wall off the north, and a roped sparring ring stands open on the party's side. Narrow lanes between canvas, an open floor to fall back on.

tourney_fields_lists.idea: Jousting lists: a tilt barrier down the middle with one crossing, and stands closing both sides. Two long lanes side by side; you can see across the barrier but only meet at the gap.

tourney_fields_range.idea: A small archery range: butts side by side at the far end of an open lane, dummies and quintains in rows either side. Cross the open lane, or creep along behind the rows.

village_gardens.idea: Two fenced garden plots, each with one gate on its south side. Each is a pocket with one way in; the wide lane between them is where the fight starts.

village_green.idea: A green round a well, cottages on both sides, a few trees. The well is the only cover in the middle, so the fight opens across the green.

village_lanes.idea: Two straight rows of cottages, each from its own side of the map, overlap in the middle, with gardens, a well and a washing line on the open ground round them. The lane between them is short and hidden from both ends, with a cart left in it, so nobody sees round the corner until they're in it.

village_street.idea: The village street, straight up the map between cottages, with a well and a tree breaking up the verges. The street is the quick way; the verges are the way round.

volcanic_peaks_crater.idea: A great crater cone in the middle of the map, a basalt rise on its west with two long flights and a lava fissure on its east. The fight goes round the cone.

volcanic_peaks_fissures.idea: Two lava fissures run in from the north corners and nearly meet at the middle. Three ways through: one narrow gap at the centre, the long ways round at each side. A smoking cone stands to the south-east.

volcanic_peaks_ledge.idea: A cliff streaked with lava across the north, a raised ledge of ash under it, one lava fissure on the slant below. Small, close and hot: the ledge is two flights and a few steps away.

windmill_country_fields.idea: Two fields of ripe wheat with a big mill between them. The wheat can be walked through; the mill and haystacks are the only hard corners.

windmill_country_mill.idea: A big mill in a wide fenced yard, with four gates. Whoever gets inside fights round the mill with their backs to the fence.

windmill_country_road.idea: A cart road up the middle between fenced fields, a cart stuck on it. The gates are halfway up: stay on the road and be seen, or go through and flank.

windmill_country_stacks.idea: A small cut field dotted with haystacks. Every stack is one more corner, with short sight lines between them, and no lines to hold.
